baseline.note: iteration-budget deterministic; B is a pinned constant, machine-independent

comp01.ctt.b_source: Shipped baseline values on original instances (deterministic 10M iterations, seed 12345, machine-independent; measured on the original task in 2026-08 and archived at tests/calibration/baseline_probe_10000000.tsv). Two batches on 260912 reconfirmed the same values for 13 keys, archived as B_original_instance (baseline_seconds records each key's time in that run). On 2026-09-13 the final judged set reverted to the official original instances (added in next-steps-260911.md §E2), so anchors reverted to the same instance convention; B on transformed instances is in the async package's tests/reference-transformed.json. After switching from a shared pool to 240 s per instance on 260917, a sandbox retest with the judge-v13 pipeline (isolated execution environment isolated-cpu, one shard at 1C/8G, hard limit 240 s per instance) found A==B for all 21 shipped-baseline keys, all within the time limit (maximum 59.01 s). B was unchanged (see the pool-retirement section of PROVENANCE).
